summary: Alcon Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, reporting its first-quarter 2026 earnings and other routine corporate updates. The filing includes financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026, with sales of $2.7 billion, diluted EPS of $0.39, and core diluted EPS of $0.85. It also announces a dividend of 0.28 CHF per share approved at the AGM and a new $1.5 billion share repurchase authorization over three years. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is reported. This is a routine earnings release and capital allocation update, not a special situation.
